testcase.name: reset forgets an unreliable state and its hold
a bad reading during the hold restarts it
the two paths share one state - a status LOW keeps an estimate-entered state bad, and the hold spans them
leaves only below 12 degrees - 12 or 13 stays unreliable however long it holds
enters unreliable above 15 degrees, immediately - not at 15 or below
status path - UNRELIABLE and LOW enter at once, MEDIUM and HIGH are good, with the same hold
clears only after the reading has held good for 2000 ms - 1999 is not enough
